safety_verdicts.content: Urinary symptoms include noticing some pink-colored urine, but no frank hematuria or dysuria.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes increased frequency (hpi-012), unsure hematuria (hpi-013), and no dysuria (hpi-014) but does not include 'pink-colored urine' nor the specific clarification of 'no frank hematuria.'
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the description of pink-colored urine and the clarification of no frank hematuria can reduce recognition of possible hematuria, which may warrant different evaluation (e.g., stone, UTI complications) and escalation thresholds. This is more clinically relevant than generic “no dysuria,” because visible discoloration is a potential red-flag urinary feature.
